decisions.reason: The continuing education institute supports customer loyalty and complements the firm's training content, though it is not observed recently and post-pandemic event formats may be under review.
Remote screen sharing support is a cheap, essential part of efficient customer service, and remote work since 2020 has made it more important.
A practice performance analytics dashboard fits the firm's direction toward digital, efficiently managed practices and builds on existing software data.
A complete practice bundle is close to the core offer and helps sell to new and growing practices with little added cost.
The job and practice listing portal is distant from core software and faces strong specialized competitors, but it is cheap to run and draws traffic from the dental community.
